case.summary: Transaction $99.92 on card C07987-K2 (December 1, 2016, online) triggered a 0.90 model score and was investigated using graph-based fraud detection. Evidence supports card-not-present fraud: the device is new to this account, the cardholder explicitly denied the transaction while confirming they retained the physical card, and the card history shows three prior confirmed frauds. Fraud probability assessed at 0.95. Action: block the card and create an internal investigation case; exposure threshold for regulatory filing is not met.
